mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, we are looking at 56 degrees with overcast skies near Verona Community Park.

The City of Verona has announced that the Plan Commission will meet on November 4th to discuss various proposals, including residential plats on Jenna Drive and site plans for Milky Way. Additionally, property tax bills will be mailed out by December 15.

We have a busy weekend ahead, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can join a yoga session at Insight Wellness, followed by trivia nights throughout the week.
Regarding public safety, the Verona Police Department reported an incident on Thursday, October 15, where a school bus driver was arrested for O W I after dangerous driving was observed.
Treat yourself to today's flavor, Snickers Swirl, as the restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM.
